title: ‘Body kept in car for 7 hours’: How a Gurgaon meeting ended in HR professional’s murder
content: A 31-year-old HR professional was allegedly murdered after meeting a former colleague. Police arrested the former colleague, Anya Vats, and her partner, Sanyam Sachdeva. Investigators suspect a financial dispute led to the alleged killing of Yuvraj Singh Manchanda. The couple reportedly confessed to dumping the body in a sewer near their home. They were apprehended in Uttarakhand after fleeing the scene.

title: Raped, stabbed 8 times, body dumped: Delhi teen goes to meet friend, he calls 3 others
content: A 16-year-old girl was raped and murdered in Swaroop Nagar, Delhi. Four youths, including three minors, were apprehended by police in connection. Investigators are verifying the suspects' claims about their involvement in the crime. Forensic evidence and recovered weapons are being examined by the dedicated team. The tempo used in the incident has also been seized by authorities.

title: iPhone 18 Pro, 18 Pro Max sale begins: How much EMI you will have to pay
content: Apple's new iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max models are now available for purchase in India. Customers can choose from various storage options and attractive EMI plans. Several banks offer no-cost EMI for up to six months on these devices. Additionally, specific credit cards provide instant cashback for eligible buyers. Apple's Trade In program also allows for credit on old smartphones.

title: Calcutta HC orders CWC to return 3-year-old to couple despite adoption lapse
content: The Calcutta high court directed a Child Welfare Committee to return a three-year-old child. The committee had no legal basis to take custody of the child. The couple had been caring for the child since his birth in February 2023. The court noted the child was neither an orphan nor abandoned. The couple must now approach a court to establish their legal adoptive status.

title: The floor is rising: How India’s Asian Games medal story has changed over two decades
content: India's Asian Games medal tally has consistently surpassed fifty medals in recent editions.  Hangzhou saw India achieve its highest-ever medal haul, crossing one hundred medals.  This success reflects a broader sporting ecosystem with medals from multiple disciplines.  Olympic performance also shows progress with multiple medals in five consecutive games.  India's sporting floor is rising, indicating sustained improvement and future potential.

title: In-laws 'plotted' B'luru woman’s abduction; how 3 men tracked her hubby
content: Three men were arrested after allegedly attempting to abduct a 21-year-old woman in Bengaluru. Police stated her in-laws hired the men to forcibly return her to Rajasthan. The woman was tricked into opening her door and then forced into a vehicle. A chase ensued after the driver attempted to flee, ramming other cars. Public intervention stopped the vehicle, and the woman sought assistance from bystanders.

title: 'Human-caused warming helped prime slope for deadly Nepal-Tibet flood'
content: Researchers described it as a cascading disaster rather than conventional flood. Around 2 sq km of rock wall and glacier ice collapsed from Langtang Lirung at about 5,150 metres, plunging around 1,400 metres before turning into a debris flood. Water, rock, ice and sediment then travelled around 22km to Rasuwagadhi in seven minutes, leaving downstream settlements with almost no warning.

title: Ohio park grows nearly ninefold after adding 333 conservation acres
content: Homestead Metro Park in Hilliard, Ohio, is set to bloom with an expansive addition of 333 conservation acres, elevating its size to nearly nine times larger than before. This remarkable land transfer is a collaboration between the city and M/I Homes, paving the way for enhanced trails and natural habitats. Visitors can look forward to exploring this enlarged haven after several years of dedicated development.

title: Offshore wind farms may be quietly stealing rain from Europe's coasts; study says
content: A new study by Germany's Helmholtz-Zentrum Hereon suggests that very large offshore wind farm clusters in the North Sea and Baltic Sea could shift rainfall away from Europe's coasts. Turbines slow the wind and stir the lower atmosphere, causing more rain over the sea and less over land. Simulations show coastal rainfall in Denmark, Germany, the Netherlands and the UK could fall by up to 15% under an extreme expansion scenario.

title: Michael Jackson estate challenges Paris Jackson’s $1.16m legal fee request
content: Michael Jackson's estate, led by executor John Branca, is challenging Paris Jackson's request for $1.16 million in legal fees after she successfully disputed $625,000 in attorney bonuses. The estate argues her request includes unrelated legal work and overstates the financial benefit secured. The court will determine the reasonable amount Paris should receive.

title: Leaking cabins, hotel shortages: Asian Games face logistical problems & typhoon fears
content: The 20th Asian Games will bring together more than 17,000 athletes and officials, including Olympic and world champions. The Games are being held mainly in the port city of Nagoya and across the wider Aichi prefecture, with competition running until October 4.

title: MS Subbulakshmi's musical roots: Her mother’s veena to her grandmother’s violin
content: M.S. Subbulakshmi's life and musical journey are being adapted into a new film. Rashmika Mandanna will portray the iconic Carnatic vocalist in the upcoming biopic. The film's announcement coincided with M.S. Subbulakshmi's 110th birth anniversary. Director Gowtam Tinnanuri is helming the project, with music by Anirudh Ravichander. Actor Kamal Haasan offered encouragement to Mandanna at the film's launch event.

title: 'Do I want to annihilate them?' Trump weighs next phase of Iran war

The US military maintains a naval blockade on Iranian ports.  Recent tanker incidents raise concerns about regional stability and oil flow.  Trump will meet Gulf leaders to discuss the conflict's next phase.

title: Four days after DHS’ ‘Mr Singh’ post, Sikh trucker stabbed in US

The community fears this incident reflects a concerning climate for them.

It was also the fastest century by a batter from a Full Member nation against another Full Member nation.

title: 'In talks with payment platforms to ensure UPI fee not passed on to consumers': Govt

They also reassured that merchants will not incur additional GST costs once the MDR is implemented. This initiative aims to support more domestic players in the market and encourage innovation.

title: Steve Jobs quote: ‘Your time is limited, so don’t waste it living someone else’s life’
content: Steve Jobs inspired graduates to critically evaluate their everyday choices and to embrace their unique paths. He highlighted the limited time we have and warned against the perils of societal expectations. By sharing his own battle with cancer, he enlightened listeners about re-prioritizing life. His call to follow one’s heart and intuition continues to resonate, urging people everywhere to seek their true passions.

title: 'My biggest bet would surely be the doubles’: Neha on India’s TT medal hopes at Asiad

She also identifies mixed doubles, men’s and women’s doubles as India’s genuine medal chances and discusses Manika Batra’s absence.

title: Why Mark Zuckerberg's wife's school was shut down despite $125 million in donations,

Supported by the Chan Zuckerberg Initiative, the school struggled with academic results, which led to a unanimous decision by the board to close after funding was withdrawn. Despite mixed academic performance, it notably prioritized the health and well-being of its students, while the Initiative is now concentrating on scientific research.

title: Centre agrees to lower cut-off for NEET-SS admission
content: SC last week asked govt to reconsider its decision not to reduce the cut-off percentile . the qualifying percentile for NEET-SS may go from the existing 50th to 30th for the proposed special stray vacancy round, to be conducted soon .

title: US F-16 fighter jet crashes in Michigan, bursts into flames
content: an F-16 fighter jet from Texas crashed in rural Michigan on friday . the pilot ejects safely before being taken to a local hospital, a military spokesman says . it was taking part in exercises at a national guard base in Alpena, about 190 miles north of Detroit .

title: Russia kicks off voting in first parliamentary election since Ukraine war began
content: polling stations opened first in Russia's Far East, including Kamchatka and Chukotka, with voting continuing across the country until Sunday . the election is taking place as the war in Ukraine enters its fifth year, with Russian authorities facing growing economic pressure .

title: Flowers at 10,600ft: World’s highest twin fields unveiled in Leh
content: the gardens house more than 25 lakh high-value flowers, including 24 lakh Lilium and 1 lakh Gladiolus . the Choglamsar field was developed in just two months, with plantation beginning on July 16 and the first blooms appearing in the first week of Sept .

title: Watch: T-shirt torn, fists fly as passengers clash mid-air on Bangladesh flight
content: the fight continued until cabin crew members and other passengers intervened and managed to separate the two men . a video of the altercation shows the two passengers exchanging blows as fellow travellers looked on in panic . the incident reportedly caused panic among passengers, including children and elderly people .

title: ‘Hardik cannot bowl 10 overs’: Coach Gambhir explains Nitish Reddy's ODI selection
content: india have rarely finished with the same personnel they started with . injuries, breakdowns and availability issues have crippled team management . the think tank hasn't consistently had the opportunity to field its strongest XI, which forced insecurity to creep into the set-up .

title: 'BJP and EC join forces': Rahul Gandhi slams EC over TMC name, symbol freeze
content: sarkaar chori and now party symbol have become symbols of democratic decline in the country . opposition leader Rahul Gandhi accuses the election commission and the poll panel of joining forces to split a party . the party's election symbol is snatched away, the party leader says .

title: US likely committed war crimes in Iran strikes that killed over 150: UN
content: on february 28, missiles struck Shajareh Tayyebeh primary school in minab, southern Iran . at least 156 people were killed, including about 120 children . findings published by the independent international Fact-Finding Mission on Iran - the report to the UN human rights council .
